flow-definition.description: businessplanner (Businessplanner) base images: businessplanner-base-apt -> businessplanner-base-conan -> businessplanner-base-node. Heavy and infrequent. Builds each base, pushes it to Nexus, then prunes it locally BEFORE the next one, so peak local disk is ~one base image. base-apt is kept resident because businessplanner-base-conan builds FROM it; it is dropped at the very end. Mirrors the .github/workflows/businessplanner-base-images.yml DAG.
